projects.name: Project Work
details: 1. Healthcare Patient Management System
• Crafted a microservices-based system for managing patient data and appointments for 10,000+ patients, optimizing
MySQL and PostgreSQL queries for enhanced performance.
• Collaborated with senior engineers to improve system scalability and reduce processing time by 25%, ensuring
smooth integration during QA/UAT phases.
• Resolved production issues, minimizing system downtime by 15% and maintaining stable performance.
2. Hotel Rating Microservices Application
• Architected a microservices-based solution for core services (User, Rating, Hotel), improving scalability by 40% and
reducing communication latency by 30% through REST APIs, Feign Client, and Spring Cloud API Gateway.
• Deployed Eureka Server for service discovery and implemented Circuit Breaker patterns, ensuring 99.9% uptime
and enhancing system reliability by 25%.
• Secured microservices with OAuth2 and Okta, optimizing performance with Redis caching and improving response
times by 25%.
3. Stock Market Investing Application
• Constructed a Spring Boot application to manage stock portfolios for 500+ users.
• Architected JWT authentication and created RESTful APIs for CRUD operations, handling 100+ requests daily.
• Leveraged JPA to optimize database interactions, ensuring data integrity and reducing errors by 30%.
